budget_authorizations.scope: Cumulative campaign API expenditure, including previous attempts, failed requests, and unknown reservations.

attribution_boundary: Log filenames identify retained invocation groups. Earlier pilot requests without a current campaign log remain unattributed; this does not exclude their costs. An invocation can contain both native preparation and reader calls.
boundary: Reported receipt costs include caching. Different observed billing rates prohibit intrinsic product cost rankings. Unknown costs retain conservative reservations after consumers stopped; this is not a final provider invoice. Local compute, CI and Codex usage are excluded.
